entry.title: Release 3.0
entry.content:
Hello all,

It has now been 2 years since the very first tests of QML, Kirigami, on Linux & Windows, confirming the feasibility and next big step for Katalog user experience.
Katalog 3.0 is now Released!

✨ Katalog 3 introduction​

  • Katalog 3 marks the transition to a more modern User Interface. It relies on QtQuick (instead of QtWidgets) and Kirigami from KDE.

  • All features available in Katalog 2.12 have been ported in Katalog 3 with many improvements.

  • Katalog 2 has been maintained (bugs & light feature changes) to version 2.13, keeping full db compatiblity with Katalog 3.0.

  • Older versions of Katalog (2.12 and before) should not be used on collections opened with 2.13 or 3.0.

Katalog 3 on a Desktop using breezecolors Katalog 3 on a Desktop using openSUSE colors

✨ Main improvements​

  • #630 APP: Theme can switch to dark mode on non-Qt Desktop Environments

  • #815 APP: Adjustable font size

  • #799 APP: Open recent collections

  • #814 APP: Esc key closes the last opened page

  • #759 SELECTION: Card tree showing devices' file & space info

  • #813 SELECTION: Filter devices

  • #808 SEARCH: Multiple search text input

  • #787 SEARCH: multiple Search & exclude texts

  • #808 SEARCH: Quick filter on filename

  • #792 SEARCH, CREATE, UPDATE: common progress panel

  • #793 SEARCH, EXPLORE: Deleting files is disabled unless activated in the Settings

  • #766 SEARCH: Regular expression support for file name search

  • #791 DEVICES: Catalog Updates can be queued

  • #800 DEVICES: Table or card display

  • #781 DEVICES: Add comments to Virtual devices & Catalogs

  • #782 EXPLORE: Show folder sizes

  • #759 CREATE: Include subdirectories option (off = exclude sub folders)

  • #797 BACKUP: Duplicate backup link

  • #783 BACKUP: Edit a backup link

  • #795 BACKUP: Run multiple backup links

  • #809 SETTINGS: Quality check of the database

  • #788 SETTINGS: Refresh the status of devices upon window focus

  • #780 SETTINGS: Report updates from imported collection

  • #816 ABOUT: Button to copy system information for bug reports

⚠️ Technical changes​

  • As for any new version, it is highly recommended to backup the collections 💾, and test the new version on other copies.
  • Database updates: device comments, a separate Storage ID, and a backup option for empty folders

📦 Distribution Formats​

  • As usual, Window 64, Linux, macOS
  • Linux: for easy Linux installation, use Flathub/Flatpak

📋 Release details​

  • Full list of updates: https://github.com/StephaneCouturier/Katalog/issues?q=milestone%3A3.0+sort%3Acreated-asc
  • Full code changelog: https://github.com/StephaneCouturier/Katalog/compare/v2.12...v3.0
  • 📥 Download Katalog: https://sourceforge.net/projects/katalogg
  • 📚 Documentation: https://stephanecouturier.github.io/Katalog

entry.title: Release 3.beta1
entry.content:
Hello all,

It has now been 2 years since the very first tests of QML, Kirigami, on Linux & Windows, confirming the feasibility and next big step for Katalog user experience.
Katalog 3.0 release is near!

This is a message to call to anyone who would like to contribute and help to improve the quality before official Release. Feel free to post feedback here, or directly as issues.

✨ What is Katalog 3​

Katalog 3 is the new major version of Katalog, transitionning to a more modern User Interface. It relies on QtQuick (instead of QtWidgets) and Kirigami from KDE.

Katalog 2 will be maintained for some time to address major bugs & light feature changes. Katalog 2.13 will be released at the same time as Katalog 3.0 to maintain full db compatiblity.

This is enabled by having done a full split of UI and backend. The common use of /core (backend) means that Collections will remain compatible between both latest versions.

✨ Before testing​

  1. ⚠️ BACKUP YOUR COLLECTION(S) FIRST 💾 !

  2. CREATE A TEST COLLECTION IN KATALOG 2 BEFORE

  3. Info: to make it even safer, when opening Katalog 3 beta1 for the first time, it will NOT use the same settingsFile (.ini) and therefore it will NOT open your last Collection nor personnal settings.
    This is to protect even more your current collection and get your feedback on a fresh start as well.

  4. Important for macOS users: this version has NOT been tested on a macOS and may not start at all (previous feedback received on version 3.alpha2). Please report if it starts or not, this would be very useful.

✨ What to test​

  • Note: documentation updates are not available yet

  • New UI and global experience (starting from a blank Collection). Screenshots are very appreciated when describing an issue.

  • Conversion of a copy of a collection (low risk but important to secure) Once in Katalog 3, open a COPY of your main collection.
    ⚠️ Do not open files with Katalog 2.12 after using them in Katalog 2.13 or 3.0, some issues would appear.

  • Try out Katalog 2.13 beta1 on the same collection

  • Katalog 3 new features: see: Katalog 3 changes (it is not quite exhaustive but already a good list)

Downloads​

📦 Distribution Formats:

  • Beta versions limited to Linux AppImage & Window 64 Portable & macOS

📋 Release details:

  • 📥 Download Katalog: https://sourceforge.net/projects/katalogg/files/Katalog%203.0/beta1/
  • 📚 Documentation: https://stephanecouturier.github.io/Katalog/docs/Development-Roadmap#katalog-3

entry.title: Release 2.12 & 3.alpha2
entry.content:
✨ Katalog 2 Main improvements:

  • #766 SEARCH: Regular expression support for file name search
  • #222 SEARCH: Search History / Clear list (can keep last 10 searches)
  • #684 SEARCH: List as Search input (several text search input) Pasting a list of term (several lines) and run the search, the results is equivalent to running individual searches with sames criteria except on each different term (a term can be several words). See:Search#file-name

  • #401 DEVICES: breakdown a catalog onto 1 per file type or 1 by sub folder Split Catalog per sub directory Split Catalog per File type See:DevicesCatalogs#catalog-context-menu

  • #770 DEVICES: replace Storage root path in devices and indexes When a Storage device's mount point or drive letter changes, every indexed file/folder path become obsolete. The current fallback is a full re-scan. this feature offers a fast, offline alternative that performs a prefix-replace, without requiring the device to be mounted.

  • #776 APP: File database mode as default instead of Memory mode

  • #775 CREATE: replace the Select Storage list by a device tree

✨ Katalog 3 Preparation:

  • #747 Katalog 3 Alpha 2: Full featured app for testing and feedback Katalog 3 is now covering all features of Katalog 2 except multi-languages. See:Development-Roadmap#katalog-3 Versions: Linux AppImage only, Windows Portable only, macOS.

    ⚠️ Even if most of the code is common, this version is still an Alpha version: it still has risks of errors and can alter. USE ONLY ON A COPY of YOUR COLLECTION.

⚠️ Technical changes:

  • As for any new version, it is highly recommended to backup the collections 💾, and test the new version on other copies.
  • Database updates: added fields to support collections import and image folder

  • As usual, Window 64, Linux, macOS

entry.title: Release 2.9
entry.content:
✨ Main improvements:

  • #664 CREATE/SEARCH: File Checksum SH256 for Duplicate/Difference Search It is now possible to compute and store files checksum in the catalogs. It is a much longer process than other indexing option as it reads ALL of the data to compute the checksums. Like file metadata, the option can be selected at catalog creation or changed later, and when interrupting the process, the calculated checksum are saved and the next update will resume for remaining files. The files checkum can be used as a duplicate search option or as a difference search option

  • #402 DATA: Store data in a local MySQL/mariadb database. Beside Memory or SQLite File modes, it is now possible to store data in a local hosted db. For the local machine, it can present a good compromise between speed of indexing vs speed of searching. It is ONLY for USE with LOCAL hosted db (ex: MySQL server installed on the computer using Katalog). Communication to a remote database would not be encrypted nor secured.

  • #675 BACKUP: Generate LuckyBackup profile from BackUp links Mostly for Linux users, the catalog links (mappings) done in the tab BackUp can now be used to generate a LuckyBackup profile. These are basic profiles (task name, source, destination), no exclude or advanced options.

  • #692 SEARCH Duplicates: new option to compare 2 devices

⚠️ Technical changes:

  • As for any new version, it is highly recommended to backup the collections 💾, and test the new version on other copies.
  • Database updates: added fields to store checksum and new search duplicates options

📦 Distribution Formats:

  • As usual, Window 64, Linux, macOS
  • Reminder: AppImage is available for easier Linux deployment, including one for older/LTS distributions with glibc 2.35 (ex: Ubuntu 22..04) It is still possible to use the Command Line Interface with AppImage.

entry.title: Release 2.8
entry.content:
✨ Main improvements:

  • #379 CREATE/ SEARCH: File Types management Instead of hard-coded and limited list, Katalog now uses a standard database, with more than 1200 known types, to determine the type from the extension and it can also verify the real mime type and report gaps. The definition of main types "Images, Audio, Video" is strictly related, only the type "Text" was customized to include types such as PDF. see Create#file-type-categories

  • #379 CREATE/ SEARCH: File Metadata management Basic Media (Image size, Video duration, Music artist, etc.) or Extended (all available) metadata can be scanned, stored, and used in searching. see Create#metadata-extraction for the different options. Important: indexing metadata is a much, much slower process than just indexing them. (ex: 45minutes for 100 000 files) Which is why it comes with another new major feature:

  • #662 DEVICES: Incremental update Updating a device will only process new or modified files, which is a critical need to save time when using File Metadata and avoid re-scanning them when files have not changed.

  • #660 CREATE/ SEARCH/DEVICES: consistent operations progress reporting in status bar

⚠️ Technical changes:

  • As for any new version, it is highly recommended to backup the collections 💾, and test the new version on other copies.
  • Database update: significant changes have been made as fields were added to store metadata
  • Catalogs migration: all catalog will require an operation to populate the new file_types & mime-types. This will happen only once, per catalog, and when using Search or Explore for the first time.

📦 Distribution Formats:

  • New! Katalog is now provided for Apple macOS (dmg file or zip) note: ⚠️ Katalog was not tested on macOS, feedback is very welcome
  • Reminder: AppImage is available for easier Linux deployment, including one for older/LTS distributions with glibc 2.35 (ex: Ubuntu 22..04) It is now the default version when downloading from on SourceForge. It is still possible to use the Command Line Interface with AppImage

entry.title: A test of QML and Kirigami for Katalog
entry.summary: Looking at the future of Katalog, a few directions were here from the start of the project:
entry.content:
Looking at the future of Katalog, a few directions were here from the start of the project:

  • Multi-platform: why not even consider Mobile ? (ok, macOS should really be addressed before)
  • Using KDE KF6 librairies: this could be the best way to grow capabilities such a archives indexing or media files meta data
  • User Experience: nicer interface, more responsive.

It happens that there is now a way to address all that at once: QML with Kirigami

  • QML is the modern interface design code from Qt (which makes 100% of Katalog today)
  • Kirigami is the QML based framework by KDE to provide additional interface and consistency in the KDE world.

Well, so far it works :) Installation of the Kirigami:

  • Linux (using kdebuild)
  • Windows (using Craft)

entry.title: Major Release 2.0
entry.summary: Après avoir publié 1 version de Katalog chaque mois et comme aucun bug majeur n'avait été signalé, les versions ont été suspendues depuis juillet dernier pour permettre de travailler sur cette prochaine grande version.
entry.content:
Après avoir publié 1 version de Katalog chaque mois et comme aucun bug majeur n'avait été signalé, les versions ont été suspendues depuis juillet dernier pour permettre de travailler sur cette prochaine grande version.

Voici enfin la release 2.0 : Release Notes

Ce développement s'est concentré sur 2 principaux catalyseurs :

  • Périphériques : les listes de périphériques virtuels, de stockage et de catalogue sont désormais toutes accessibles à partir d'un seul onglet fournissant l'équivalent sur les 3 onglets précédents. Il offre la flexibilité de créer une hiérarchie globale d'appareils pour améliorer les fonctionnalités de recherche ou de statistiques.

  • Les données peuvent désormais être gérées dans un fichier de base de données (format SQLite), tout en conservant la possibilité de conserver les fichiers CSV traditionnels. Cela permettra également une future option pour héberger la base de données sur un serveur.

Ces changements impliquaient des mises à jour majeures du modèle de données et de la gestion des données.
Par conséquent, la version prend en charge une procédure de migration 1.x > 2.0.

⚠ Sauvegardez auparavant les données de votre collection Katalog créées avec les versions précédentes. ⚠

Pour en savoir plus sur ces principaux changements, explorez les pages Périphériques et Paramètres de la Documentation.

Tous les commentaires via Facebook, Github, e-mail sont toujours appréciés 😉
